engines.name: Engines
engines.desc: Drives, reaction mass and the limits of acceleration.

communication.name: Communication
communication.desc: Relays, sensors and the reach of the empire's voice.

planetary.name: Planetary science
planetary.desc: Worlds: surveying, living on them, remaking them.

sociology.name: Sociology
sociology.desc: People across light-years: medicine, law and loyalty.

projectile.name: Projectile weapons
projectile.desc: Mass thrown hard: from coilguns to relativistic slugs.

energy.name: Energy weapons
energy.desc: Lasers, beams and the fields that stop them.

missiles.name: Missiles and drones
missiles.desc: Ordnance that thinks, swarms and multiplies.

wormholes.name: Wormhole utilisation
wormholes.desc: Finding, holding open and one day making wormholes.

exotic.name: Exotic and alien
exotic.desc: Relics, alien minds and physics nobody taught us.

plasma.name: Confined plasma physics
plasma.desc: The physics of holding a fusion plasma in magnetic fields.

torch.name: Early fusion torch
torch.desc: A slow, reliable fusion drive: 0.1 g, cruising at a tenth of light.

nozzle.name: Magnetic nozzle theory
nozzle.desc: Shaping exhaust with fields instead of walls that would melt.

torch-2.name: Advanced fusion torch
torch-2.desc: Hotter, harder burns: 0.3 g up to 0.3 c.

scoop.name: Interstellar ramscoop
scoop.desc: Gathering hydrogen from the thin medium between stars.

sail.name: Laser-pushed sail
sail.desc: Light sails driven by beamers at home; no fuel carried.

antimatter.name: Antimatter production
antimatter.desc: Making and storing antimatter in quantities that matter.

am-drive.name: Antimatter drive
am-drive.desc: One gravity of thrust, cruising at six tenths of light.

inertial.name: Inertial frame theory
inertial.desc: Hints that inertia itself might be negotiable.

hardburn.name: High-g burn protocols
hardburn.desc: Crews in tanks, hulls braced: three gravities for short burns.

near-c.name: Near-light kinematics
near-c.desc: What a hull must survive to live at the edge of light speed.

spaceframes.name: Frigate spaceframes
spaceframes.desc: Hulls strong enough to carry real weapons at a tenth of light.

capital-ships.name: Capital spaceframes
capital-ships.desc: Cruisers: ships that are small cities, and cost like them.

cold-drive.name: Cold-exhaust drives
cold-drive.desc: Gentle burns that barely glow. Allows stealth approaches; plumes are fainter.

signalling.name: Coherent signalling
signalling.desc: Tight laser beams that stay readable across light-years.

relay.name: Relay station
relay.desc: The backbone of the empire: 20 ly of reach.

optics.name: Adaptive optics
optics.desc: Correcting beams and mirrors on the fly.

interferometry.name: Deep-space interferometry
interferometry.desc: Arrays that catch plumes from wider angles.

pickets.name: Sensor pickets
pickets.desc: Watching drones seeded around a system: plume range +5 ly.

neutrino.name: Neutrino signalling theory
neutrino.desc: Messages that pass through planets and dust.

entangle.name: Entanglement channel theory
entangle.desc: A forbidden idea: correlation without delay.

ansible.name: Ansible pair
ansible.desc: Two devices that speak instantly, at any distance.

tight-beams.name: Tight-beam discipline
tight-beams.desc: Narrower beams, less spill: half as easy to overhear.

intercept.name: Beam-spill interception
intercept.desc: Catching the edges of other empires' beams: listening reach +1.5 ly.

quantum-keys.name: Quantum-keyed channels
quantum-keys.desc: Keys that reveal any eavesdropper: cipher strength +2.

sensor-net.name: Sensor nets
sensor-net.desc: Drifting sensors around a system see anything that moves nearby, burning or not.

deep-net.name: Deep sensor nets
deep-net.desc: Nets light-years wide, strung with neutrino detectors.

computation.name: Distributed computation
computation.desc: Computers spread across a system, sharing work.

pattern.name: Pattern recognition
pattern.desc: Finding the signal in oceans of noise.

beta.name: Beta-level simulation
beta.desc: Convincing simulations of people, without a person inside.

governors.name: Simulated governors
governors.desc: Beta-level stand-ins that rule where no human will go.

network.name: Networked research
network.desc: Institutes working as one mind: research +15 %.

alpha.name: Alpha-level uploads
alpha.desc: A person, copied into the machine. Or so it claims.

oracle.name: Machine oracles
oracle.desc: Minds that answer questions nobody asked: research +25 %.

ciphers.name: Classical ciphers
ciphers.desc: Every message leaves encrypted; every empire can read the weakest codes.

keys.name: Key distribution protocols
keys.desc: Fresh keys carried by ships: cipher strength +1.

lattice.name: Lattice cryptography
lattice.desc: Problems hard even for minds far larger than ours.

lattice-ciphers.name: Lattice-sealed relays
lattice-ciphers.desc: Relay traffic sealed in lattices: cipher strength +2.

codebreakers.name: Beta-level codebreakers
codebreakers.desc: Simulated minds that never tire of other people's secrets: decryption +2.

battle-computers.name: Battle computers
battle-computers.desc: Plans executed in microseconds, because nothing else is fast enough.

habitats.name: Orbital habitats
habitats.desc: Spinning cities where no world will have us. Makes generation arks possible and doubles what an orbital base can hold.

climate.name: Climate dynamics
climate.desc: How atmospheres balance, and how they fail.

containment.name: Magnetic containment
containment.desc: Safe bottles for plasma and antimatter.

giants.name: Gas giant skimming
giants.desc: Diving into giants for fuel and volatiles. Stations grow larger and busier.

processors.name: Atmosphere processors
processors.desc: Machines that slowly rewrite the air of a world. Halves the time of terraforming.

biosphere.name: Engineered biospheres
biosphere.desc: Designing living systems that can hold a planet together.

terraform.name: Full terraforming
terraform.desc: Centuries of work to make a new Earth.

life-support.name: Closed life support
life-support.desc: Air, water and food recycled in sealed loops. Without it no dome or station feeds itself.

hydroponics.name: Hydroponic farming
hydroponics.desc: Crops under lamps, in water, in the dark between stars.

domes.name: Pressure domes
domes.desc: Towns under glass on worlds that would kill us in a breath.

shelters.name: Storm shelters
shelters.desc: Deep vaults to wait out a flare, when there is warning.

asteroid-mining.name: Asteroid mining
asteroid-mining.desc: Ore without gravity wells to climb out of.

flare-forecast.name: Flare forecasting
flare-forecast.desc: Reading a restless star well enough to hide in time.

resilient-crops.name: Resilient crops
resilient-crops.desc: Many strains, no single blight. A harvest that fails only in part.

automation.name: Industrial automation
automation.desc: Factories that need few hands, for colonies that have few.

arcologies.name: Arcologies
arcologies.desc: Cities as single buildings, a world's capacity multiplied.

seeders.name: Seeder robotics
seeders.desc: Robot ships that land ahead of the colonists and build: habitats, nurseries, fields. Unlocks robotic preparation missions.

hardened-robotics.name: Hardened robotics
hardened-robotics.desc: Machines that survive decades alone under a hostile sky. Preparations fail half as often.

microbial-seeding.name: Microbial seeding
microbial-seeding.desc: Seeders sow engineered microbes: a terraformable world starts to change before anyone lands.

self-replicators.name: Self-replicating builders
self-replicators.desc: Robots that build more robots. Preparations take half the time.

ecopoiesis.name: Ecopoiesis
ecopoiesis.desc: A biosphere grown from seed: colonies on seeded worlds keep terraforming, slowly, without full terraforming.

gaian.name: Gaian engineering
gaian.desc: Whole worlds steered like gardens. Terraforming goes half again as fast.

administration.name: Interstellar administration
administration.desc: Governing people you will never hear from in time.

biostasis.name: Biostasis medicine
biostasis.desc: Slowing a body almost to a stop, and starting it again.

legitimacy.name: Theory of distant legitimacy
legitimacy.desc: Why colonies decades away still obey, and when they stop.

cryo.name: Cryo-sleep cohorts
cryo.desc: Colonists sleep through the crossing and wake as themselves: a settled society from the first day.

missions.name: Cultural missions
missions.desc: Songs, archives and envoys that remind colonies who they are. Lets governors send missions that restore a colony's loyalty.

charters.name: Colonial charters
charters.desc: Written freedoms that slow the drift toward independence.

longevity.name: Longevity treatments
longevity.desc: Lives measured in centuries; populations that grow while no one dies.

neural.name: Neural interfacing
neural.desc: Machines in the skull, and what they do to a self.

consensus.name: Consensus networks
consensus.desc: Minds linked into a single will. Some call it a hive. Colonies drift far less.

plague.name: Nanotech plague defence
plague.desc: Surviving the rot that eats machines inside and outside the body.

agents.name: Agent networks
agents.desc: People in other empires' courts, decades from home.

nurseries.name: Machine nurseries
nurseries.desc: Frozen embryos, artificial wombs and machine teachers. The first generations are raised by things that are not people, and it shows.

genetics.name: Population genetics
genetics.desc: How small, closed peoples drift, sicken and survive.

prion-therapy.name: Prion therapeutics
prion-therapy.desc: Against the slow folding sickness that haunts closed habitats.

gene-banks.name: Gene banks
gene-banks.desc: Diversity carried in ice to every new world.

founding.name: Founding traditions
founding.desc: Stories, rites and charters that hold a young colony together.

tutors.name: Tutor intelligences
tutors.desc: Patient machine teachers who remember what the parents never knew.

calendar.name: Common calendar
calendar.desc: One reckoning of time and one archive across light-years: distance divides a little less.

broadcasts.name: Home broadcasts
broadcasts.desc: The capital's voice, years old but never silent, in every colony's sky.

development.name: Developmental psychology
development.desc: How children become people, and what happens when no people raise them.

curricula.name: Nursery curricula
curricula.desc: What the machines should teach the first generation: stories, faces, a home they never saw.

surrogates.name: Surrogate minds
surrogates.desc: Simulated parents with human patience. Embryo-born societies grow up far less strange.

diaspora.name: Diaspora studies
diaspora.desc: Why peoples scattered across light-years stay one, and why they stop.

compact.name: Federal compact
compact.desc: A union colonies may leave, and therefore rarely do.

memetics.name: Memetic engineering
memetics.desc: Ideas designed to spread and to bind. Useful, and not entirely honest.

coilgun.name: Coilgun
coilgun.desc: Magnetic coils hurl slugs at kilometres per second.

hypervelocity.name: Hypervelocity impact physics
hypervelocity.desc: When impact speed beats the speed of sound in the target.

flechette.name: Flechette clouds
flechette.desc: Countless needles in the path of a crossing fleet.

debris.name: Debris screens
debris.desc: Sacrificial clouds that stop what cannot be dodged.

rkv.name: Relativistic kill vehicles
rkv.desc: Dumb mass at a fraction of light: nothing stops it.

vault.name: Vault ordnance
vault.desc: Weapons kept sealed for centuries, meant for worlds, not ships.

whipple.name: Whipple shields
whipple.desc: Layers that turn a slug into spray before it reaches the hull.

batteries.name: Orbital batteries
batteries.desc: Guns and point defences around an inhabited world.

optics.name: High-energy optics
optics.desc: Mirrors and lenses that survive their own light.

fields.name: Field theory
fields.desc: Electromagnetic fields as tools and armour.

laser.name: Combat lasers
laser.desc: Light that burns at a hundred thousand kilometres.

particle.name: Particle beam physics
particle.desc: Accelerating matter itself into a weapon.

shielding.name: Plasma shielding
shielding.desc: Hot fields that spread incoming energy.

graser.name: Gamma-ray laser
graser.desc: The hardest light: short range, no defence.

pd-lasers.name: Point-defence lasers
pd-lasers.desc: Fast lasers that burn missiles out of the sky.

defense-shield.name: Planetary field shields
defense-shield.desc: Fields over a world that scatter beams.

autonomy.name: Autonomous targeting
autonomy.desc: Ordnance that decides for itself, seconds from the enemy.

swarm.name: Drone swarms
swarm.desc: Hundreds of small minds hunting together.

replication.name: Self-replication theory
replication.desc: Machines that build their own children from rubble.

replicators.name: Self-replicating drones
replicators.desc: A weapon that grows. And may not stop.

interceptors.name: Interceptor drones
interceptors.desc: Small hunters that meet slugs and impactors far out.

detection.name: Wormhole detection
detection.desc: Finding throats by the way they bend starlight.

exotic.name: Exotic matter synthesis
exotic.desc: Negative energy density, a few atoms at a time.

couriers.name: Throat courier routing
couriers.desc: Automatic couriers that carry news through known throats.

stabilization.name: Throat stabilization
stabilization.desc: Keeping a wormhole open under heavy traffic.

transit.name: Traversable-throat engineering
transit.desc: The theory behind making wormholes, not just using them.

portable.name: Portable mouths
portable.desc: Towing one end of a wormhole to a new star.

xenoarch.name: Xenoarchaeology
xenoarch.desc: Reading ruins older than our species.

relic-salvage.name: Relic salvage
relic-salvage.desc: Taking alien machines apart without waking them.

machine-signatures.name: Dormant machine signatures
machine-signatures.desc: Faint regularities in old stars: something watches for noise.

ocean-contact.name: Ocean-mind contact
ocean-contact.desc: Swimming into a living ocean that remembers every visitor.

relic-physics.name: Relic physics
relic-physics.desc: Laws of nature as the builders used them.

silence.name: Signature discipline
silence.desc: Burning quietly, so that whatever listens does not hear us.

nanotech.name: Alien nanotechnology
nanotech.desc: Machines smaller than viruses and older than suns.
